_AutofillStore_Note: Deliberately NO AutofillStore:Directory override here. The deployed service on intelligence reports 'Hosting environment: Development' (the estate's env files win over the unit's ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production), so anything in this file is live in production too - a relative store path here would land inside the deploy path and be wiped every release. For a local `dotnet run`, set the env var AutofillStore__Directory=autofill-store (or any writable folder) instead.
